business_problem: Fluent Commerce needed to turn retailer fulfillment data into trusted, actionable insights for business users instead of trapping operational questions in engineering backlogs and static reports.
solution_summary: Fluent Commerce uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Fluent Commerce needed to turn retailer fulfillment data into trusted, actionable insights for business users instead of trapping operational questions in engineering backlogs and static reports. Looker powers Fluent Analytics and the conversational interface business users employ to ask fulfillment questions in natural language, serving as the serving layer. BigQuery stores the data-rich environment that supports fulfillment analytics and experimentation, serving as the storage layer. Fulfillment and operational data is stored in BigQuery, Looker and LookML abstract that complexity into business terms, and conversational agents let retailers query performance, test operational changes, and immediately see the results in the same analytics stream. Fluent Commerce gave retail operators faster, trusted answers and shortened the path from fulfillment insight to operational action.
